name: 請求管理の各ページを切り替えるセクションタブ
prompt:
Second attempt. Recreate only the supplied Slack billing section-tab strip at 1220x64 px with Japanese labels. This is a very shallow, single horizontal row on white, with a fine pale-gray bottom divider. No other page content.

Place exactly six labels, vertically centered at y≈32, using these tab-center x coordinates: 「概要」 center x=71; 「履歴」 center x=243; 「設定」 center x=420; 「連絡先」 center x=601; 「メンバー変更」 center x=835; 「支払い方法」 center x=1106. Keep these centers fixed; do not spread the shorter Japanese words more evenly or move the final tab left. Use compact 16 px Japanese system sans. The first five labels are medium-weight Slack blue; 「支払い方法」 is semibold dark charcoal.

The selected tab box is fixed at x=989 to the right crop edge x=1220, full row height 64 px, with only subtle pale-gray top and side borders and no filled background. Its label stays centered at x=1106. Keep all tabs one line, preserve the source's uneven spacing and broad gaps, and do not add icons, badges, underlines, extra labels, or a separate tab card.
reviewNotes: 6項目の文字中心は指定位置からおおむね10 px以内。選択された支払い方法タブの左枠が原図より約17 px左にあり、選択枠の幅が広い。目視確認済みだが、この幾何差を要修正として記録。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
